objective: Make provider content-side stop pressure visible in E4 resource continuity. An unrecovered provider content-side stop is now truthfully attributed (provider_content_stop), visible through e3-status/e3-trace/e3-why, returned from the orchestrator boundary, and recorded by the execution rehearsal driver - but E4's resource-continuity surface still measures only tokens, cost and time-to-exhaustion, so a provider (or provider/model pair) that repeatedly withholds content while still consuming prompt tokens is reported as healthy capacity. Surface the recorded content-side stop pressure through the E4/operator-facing resource-continuity status using evidence already on disk (per worker/provider/model: stops observed, attempts observed, stop rate, the last observed finishReason, and a bounded flag that content was withheld at a measurable rate), so an operator or the owner can see the degradation before a whole workflow silently burns its budget on stops. Evidence-driven and offline (0 real provider calls): consume the recorded dispatch-attempt / performance-evidence rows and the recorded IMAGE_RECITATION series; do not re-run any provider series.
